# openstack-ironic-operator-kog — LLM doc index
# One line per file. The four charts version independently; read a chart at the version in its
# CompositionDefinition (manifests/compositiondefinition-<name>.yaml, spec.chart.version).
docs/index.md: the map — the KOG + composition architecture and links to the whole bundle
docs/overview.md: the two layers (KOG primitives + lookup-driven per-state composition), the four charts, delete-vs-undeploy
docs/usage.md: free local kind + standalone Ironic env, driving a composition with cdc, apply-at-the-right-apiVersion, real Ironic
docs/configuration.md: the value surface of each chart + the singleton NodeConfiguration
docs/api.md: the CompositionDefinition CRD, the four generated composition CRDs, the KOG Ironic primitives
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how the four charts are published to GHCR (release-chart.yaml)
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/baremetal-lifecycle/README.md: a BaremetalLifecycle CR that walks a node enroll -> active
examples/baremetal-lifecycle/composition.yaml: the composition CR itself
# Deep-dive references (design + runbook):
docs/KUBERNETES-CLUSTER.md: the layered kubernetes-cluster composition (kubeadm over Ironic blades)
docs/KUBERNETES-CLUSTER-PLAN.md: the kubernetes-cluster implementation roadmap
docs/KUBERNETES-CLUSTER-V0.11.0-DESIGN.md: external-etcd HA design (systemd unit, static bootstrap)
docs/USER-GUIDE.md: the BaremetalHost composition user guide
docs/VS-METAL3.md: comparison against metal3's baremetal-operator
docs/BIFROST.md: run against real standalone Ironic via Bifrost (real PXE, no Keystone)
docs/REAL-IRONIC.md: run against a Keystone-protected Ironic via the auth proxy
docs/E2E.md: end-to-end validation on the fake driver
docs/TEST-PLAN.md: the baremetal-host chart E2E test plan
docs/ORPHAN-RECOVERY.md: recovering a desynced helm release
docs/RUNBOOK-ETCD-RESTORE.md: restoring HA etcd from a chart snapshot
docs/quickstart.md: first-time smoke test with the openstack baremetal CLI
# Source (read at the matching chart version):
charts/baremetal-host/values.yaml: the unified BaremetalHost composition values
charts/baremetal-lifecycle/values.yaml: the provisioning-only composition values
charts/baremetal-discovery/values.yaml: the discovery-only composition values
charts/kubernetes-cluster/values.yaml: the kubeadm-cluster composition values
manifests/compositiondefinition-baremetal-host.yaml: registers the baremetal-host chart
manifests/compositiondefinition-baremetal-lifecycle.yaml: registers the baremetal-lifecycle chart
manifests/compositiondefinition-baremetal-discovery.yaml: registers the baremetal-discovery chart
manifests/compositiondefinition-kubernetes-cluster.yaml: registers the kubernetes-cluster chart
manifests/restdefinition-node.yaml: KOG Node CRUD RestDefinition
manifests/restdefinition-provision.yaml: KOG NodeProvision action RestDefinition
